aboutParagraphs: Hey, I’m Utsav, currently a Private Equity Analyst at Gain.ai. I have experience in investment research, deal tracking, and financial analysis across PE/VC-backed and public companies. I’m skilled in financial modelling, due diligence, and market mapping, with a background in strategy and data analytics that enables structured, data-driven decision-making.

bullets: Researched and analyzed data on private, PE/VC-backed, and public companies from diverse sources
Insights from press releases, SEC filings (10-K/Q, S-1, D), industry reports, and market intelligence
Tracked a wide range of deal types including LBO/Buyout, M&A, Add-on, Growth Equity, PIPE and Secondary transactions
Aggregated and structured large datasets on company financials, ownership structures, and transaction history
Conducted in-depth market research and competitive intelligence to shape go-to-market strategy and pricing frameworks
Analyzed consumer behavior, competitor positioning, and monetization models, to support decision-making
Applied SQL and Python-based analysis to support data-driven insights and reporting requirements
